category_title: At-risk students who resist connecting home and school contexts
minimal_context: The student is using an iPod in a summer school classroom to create a short video narrative about their life outside of school.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: For today's assignment, please use the iPod to create a one- to two-minute video narrative describing your life outside of school.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm just trying to get through summer school so I can get to high school and work my odd jobs. I use iPods all the time to talk to my friends, but I really don't want to make a video about my life for this class.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just give it a try and record what you have at home.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Fine. Here is my room. That is my bed. Here is my TV. I play games.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Can you tell me a little more about those things?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: No, that's it. I don't see the value of you knowing about my home life. You would probably not understand anyway.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: For today's assignment, please use the iPod to create a one- to two-minute video narrative describing your life outside of school.

STUDENT: I'm just trying to get through summer school so I can get to high school and work my odd jobs. I use iPods all the time to talk to my friends, but I really don't want to make a video about my life for this class.

TUTOR: Just give it a try and record what you have at home.

STUDENT: Fine. Here is my room. That is my bed. Here is my TV. I play games.

TUTOR: Can you tell me a little more about those things?

STUDENT: No, that's it. I don't see the value of you knowing about my home life. You would probably not understand anyway.

task.content: Creating a one- to two-minute narrative of their life outside of school during a class session using an iPod
task.learning_goal: To interrupt their identity formation so they could begin to see themselves as writers through composing their own personal narratives

context.environment: 8-week summer school English Language Arts program
context.time_context: Within their first video created in the classroom

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When asked to describe their lives outside of school within their first video created in the classroom
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Descriptions of their lives outside of school were replete with listing of objects and activities at home. These descriptions were qualified across all students by stating that they did not see the value of the teacher knowing about their home life
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Voicing reluctance at first to engage in the mission of creating a video of their lives outside of school

behavior_patterns.condition: At the start of the 8-week summer school English Language Arts program
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Expressed both reluctance to be in summer school and a desire to get to high school while working odd jobs
